messages:
mira: hey all — quick heads up: flight delayed, getting rerouted. i was supposed to be primary for 21:00-23:00 UTC window. i can try to cover remotely but likely flaky. can someone take primary for that two-hour block? i can stay shadowing + handover notes. cc @alejandro @zheng :airplane:

oncall-bot: rota-check: mira is primary for slot 21:00-23:00 UTC. current backup: alejandro. to reassign, reply with `take` or `swap` in-thread.

incident-bot: active incidents: 1) embed-pipeline latency spike (sev3) — increased 95th p99 from 140ms -> 420ms since 20:45 UTC. alerts in #incidents. no user-facing errors but elevated token cost.

alejandro: taking this. i'll be primary 21:00-23:00 UTC. mira, please paste any quick runbook pointers if there are hot toggles or canary routes. :thumbsup:

mira: thanks @alejandro — two quick things:
- canary routing is enabled for eu-region; if you see queue depth > 800, flip canary to fallback pool (see runbook).
- prefix-cache eviction we rolled out at 18:30, might still warming; higher latency on first tokens.
- if embeddings pipeline hits errors, fallback to smaller batch size 8 (cmd below).

zheng: noted. alejandro, i'll forward the trace links and the grafana panels. PS — if you need to escalate, ping `eng-sre` and set incident priority to P1 only if user errors occur.

josiah: quick swap checklist (minimal):
1) alejandro posts `take` in this thread (done).
2) mira, confirm you hand over pager and update incident channel status.
3) alejandro, run these checks within first 5m:
```
# verify health
curl -sS https://health.redwood.dev/embed | jq .status
# check queue depth
kubectl -n inference get hpa embed-pool -o yaml | grep -i queue
# reduce batch if errors
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/embed-pool BATCH_SIZE=8
```
4) update rota tool: <https://rota.internal.company/slots|rota link> -> mark mira shadow.

alejandro: ran the health check a few mins ago, embed health is green but 95th up. i'll keep an eye. taking pager now. `take`

mira: handing over: i'm toggling myself to shadow in rota now. leaving this short snippet from the runbook for quick rollback of canary routing:
```
# rollback canary
POST https://admin.redwood.dev/routing/canary
{
  "region": "eu",
  "action": "disable",
  "reason": "primary handoff - reduce latency spike exposure"
}
```

alejandro: got it. i'll keep traffic on main pool and only flip canary if p95 > 600ms for 10m. i'll post any changes here.

incident-bot: note: if embed-pipeline errors > 5% for 2 consecutive 5m windows, automated fallback to cpu-quantized model will trigger. manual override available.

zheng: alejandro — pm me if you try fallback; we need to watch cost delta. also FYI customer-impact watch: support queue has two tickets referencing slowness but no escalations yet.

mira: thanks all. i'm still reachable via DM but will be at the gate. alejandro — appreciate the pickup. i'll add a short post-flight debrief tomorrow morning with timelines and any telemetries i collected. :pray:

alejandro: np, i'll keep the thread updated every 15m and post a final handback at 23:00 UTC.

josiah: great handoff. tagging runbook links for future: <https://wiki.redwood.dev/runbooks/embed-pipeline|embed runbook>, <https://wiki.redwood.dev/playbooks/oncall-handovers|handover playbook>.

mira: confirmed shadow status in rota. thread closed unless something comes up. thanks! :white_check_mark:
